summary: Build practical predictive maintenance skills with Python, ISO 17359, and machine-learning exercises. Develop models, dashboards, and an implementation roadmap.
lede: Predictive maintenance with machine learning uses equipment and maintenance data to help reliability engineers, maintenance managers, and analysts anticipate failures. Learners practise checking sensor-data quality, preparing time-series records and failure-prediction features, comparing and validating models, and translating alert thresholds into maintenance priorities using Python, pandas, and scikit-learn.
audienceIntro: Predictive maintenance training suits professionals who connect asset condition, operational data, maintenance planning, and reliability decisions. It supports intermediate to advanced learners who can interpret equipment and maintenance records and want structured practice with machine-learning workflows.
prerequisites: You should have working knowledge of industrial equipment, maintenance planning, reliability concepts, or operational data. Familiarity with spreadsheets and basic statistics is recommended. No production software-engineering experience is required, and coding is limited to guided Python and pandas exercises. Advanced machine-learning topics are taught at the operational application level, with selected model-building exercises using prepared datasets.
topics: Generative AI at work & AI copilots
